title: YonkaTotemPack
description: A texture pack that replaces the totems texture into a yonkagor plushie.
body:
!IMPORTANT!
All characters in this totem texture pack are from 
[Yonkagor](https://www.youtube.com/@YonKaGor).

Have you ever wanted your favorite yonkats as totems while you play minecraft?
well here it is!

Once you download this texturepack and activate it, it will automatically change the totem to your favorite yonkat!.

I also plan to make all of yonkats if i dont lose interest in this project.

PS:I dont know how to make it use the rename item feature so right now you got to download the specific yonkatpack to change the totem.

  Right now here are all the yonkats:
- Wildflower
- Watercolor
- Tetra
- Speckle
- Selfish
- Seadrive
- Seabird
- Routine
- Papercraft
- Honestlie
- Groupie
- Goldfish
- Droplet
- Dragonet
- Copycat
- Convict
- Clownfish
- Clione
- Biased truth
- Betta/Cupang
